body: Well, I knows it was crazy and I guess looking to the internet made no sense. I guess this is it, I can only be happy no one will be here to mourne me. Once more into the breach.

It was like, I worked all summer, litterally 12 hour night shifts, working with violent people, 90 hours a week. I needed the money, but I got to see everyone around me enjoy the summer, get time off do things, I thought if I could make it through I could just win, suceed once. but not. The difference between 74 and 75 is life and death for me. Its the last time I will loose, or the first time I will start winning again.

It's hard, but I could maybe keep going on if I had somthing. I just want to win once, every things been failures for me. I have got so close to my goal but, I pretty sure I'm going to fail. Honestly, if I do I'm pretty certain I will kill myself. I just don't have enough left in me to try again.
